description: Golden J’ — Amendment 4. Re-run of Golden J with v4.2 dynamic population advancement. Static-denominator values superseded; service_funding_per_capita now reflects declining Campbell population and migration-driven Laramie growth.

_meta.amendment_reason: Engine v4.2 wires population as a per-year advancing state field. Registry denominators now use live population instead of static 2025 baseline. Campbell per-capita burden increases (fewer residents, same recapture); Laramie shows strong growth from data-center + SMR ops migration. history_digest_md5 changed because IndicatorSnapshot now records population and working_age_population, AND because per-capita denominators changed. migration_capacity_fix: countPlayerOpsJobs now reads magnitude when capacity_mw is null (player queued assets); this caused migration to be silently zero before this fix.
_meta.note: Projections are conditional forecasts under 'no further decisions,' not predictions. Python runtime uses _round_pop() (floor(n+0.5)) to match JS Math.round() semantics on .5 cases.

assertions.laramie_payback_year_range_note: Same range as Golden J — payback_year uses raw cumulative_net (not per-capita), unaffected by population dynamics.
assertions.campbell_service_funding_per_capita_2028: More negative than Golden J (-748.70) because Campbell population is declining; same recapture burden / fewer residents.
assertions.laramie_population_2028_note: Elevated above baseline (101829) due to data-center hyperscale+campus ops migration: 300 MW × 3.0 ops/MW = 900 jobs × household multiplier ≈ +2940 people over 3 years.
